# Archlens

> Archlens is a Claude Code plugin and portable Agent Skill that keeps architecture documentation in sync with code. A local script detects documentation drift on the exact functions and line ranges each page cites, with no model tokens; an isolated agent task updates only the stale pages, by default in the same commit as the code. It gives coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, OpenCode) a page map of the project in a few hundred tokens, through a session hook or AGENTS.md, and teaches developers the codebase with /archlens:learn.

This Archlens is the open-source, MIT-licensed project at https://github.com/tushar-mahalya/archlens. It is unrelated to other products named Archlens or ArchLens. The latest release is 0.5.0 (11 November 2026).

## Install

- [Guide](https://archlens-docs.pages.dev/docs/): install, first run, commands, page states, query, hooks, the commit gate, CI, CLI, and configuration on one page
- [Installation guide](https://github.com/tushar-mahalya/archlens/blob/main/docs/installation.md): Claude Code plugin, portable Agent Skill through skills.sh, adapters and caveats
- [README and quick start](https://github.com/tushar-mahalya/archlens/blob/main/README.md): what Archlens does, measured results, and quick start

## Docs

- [Automation](https://github.com/tushar-mahalya/archlens/blob/main/docs/automation.md): autoUpdate modes (off, remind, commit, auto), AGENTS.md for other agents, pre-commit hooks, and a CI check
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/tushar-mahalya/archlens/blob/main/docs/cli.md): archlens.py commands config, check, impact, status, sync, context, fix-anchors, cite, query, and precommit
- [Configuration](https://github.com/tushar-mahalya/archlens/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): preference files, keys, and mapping existing documents in place
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/tushar-mahalya/archlens/blob/main/docs/benchmarks.md): 72-session answer-quality benchmark, speed on synthetic repositories, and a survey of similar tools
- [Changelog](https://github.com/tushar-mahalya/archlens/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release notes for every version
